samples.label: 1440-front-cold-page-load
samples.timingMeaning: Fresh browser context, sampling from pre-app init script through complete loading and Begin. Includes loading frames and server/asset wait; firstFrameMs exposes any delay before the first rAF. No physical-phone or GPU-timing claim.

samples.label: 1440-front-settled-ground
samples.timingMeaning: Foreground Chrome rAF intervals during the named action plus explicit settling time, including all loading frames. p50/p95/p99 are frame scheduling, not GPU timings. renderCpuSubmissionMs is the app rolling submission counter. Interior triangle count and stale workshop/loading renderer counters are omitted. No physical-phone or sustained thermal claim.
